integrity: The analytical proof derives all-parameter statements using shared-edge conditioning, a binomial size-bias identity and finite-dimensional orthogonal projection. An independent audit and independent historical-priority assessment have not been performed. The 2026 Zegers thesis is relevant; its accessible repository abstract does not suffice to determine whether it contains equivalent covariance calculations.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to complete tournaments with independent fair edge orientations; covariance and second moments only. Does not assert joint independence, a chi-square law for the Pearson score, a multivariate central limit theorem, or extensions to biased games.
title: An exact covariance isometry for the score histogram of a fair tournament
